channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jarrett Culver | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jarrett Culver from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Chris Finch on Jarrett Culver
item.description:
Christopher Hine:Chris Finch on Jarrett Culver's surgery:

“He's still a big part of our future as we see it. So we want to be sure that we give him the best chance to have the proper preparation going into next year.”

Chris Finch on Jarrett Culver, Apr 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Ryan Saunders on Jarrett Culver
item.description:
Ryan Saunders on Jarrett Culver:

“His body is noticeably different. He's definitely added strength, especially in the upper body. He knows this is a big year. There's a lot of competition at that wing position.”

Ryan Saunders on Jarrett Culver, Dec 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Ryan Saunders on Jarrett Culver
item.description:
Timberwolves coach Ryan Saunders said Tuesday.

“You look around the league and Jarrett, the way he’s come on and the way he’s progressed, his improvement and development is a great story over this last month here. . . Being around other players like that, being around other All-Stars . . . that will really help Jarrett.”

Ryan Saunders on Jarrett Culver, Jan 22, 2020. Source: NBA.com.
